diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for disk space events
findings: Write operations blocked due to 'No space left on device'
Volume is Azure Disk Premium SSD
WAL logs not being cleaned up
Autovacuum not running due to disk pressure
No retention policy for old data
Root cause: Database growth exceeded PVC capacity
Contributing factor: WAL logs not rotated due to failed checkpoints
Database maintenance (autovacuum) blocked by disk pressure
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: PersistentVolume full due to database growth exceeding allocated capacity

recommendations.command: kubectl exec -it postgres-primary-3a4b5-c6d7e -n database -- psql -c 'VACUUM FULL ANALYZE;'
recommendations.rationale: Force vacuum to reclaim space after expansion

recommendations.command: kubectl exec -it postgres-primary-3a4b5-c6d7e -n database -- psql -c 'SELECT pg_rotate_logfile();'
recommendations.rationale: Rotate WAL logs to free up space

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: azure-disk-expandable
allowVolumeExpansion: true
provisioner: disk.csi.azure.com
parameters:
  skuName: Premium_LRS
reclaimPolicy: Retain
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Ensure storage class supports volume expansion

recommendations.command: kubectl exec -it postgres-primary-3a4b5-c6d7e -n database -- psql -c "ALTER DATABASE payments SET vacuum_cost_delay = '10ms';"
recommendations.rationale: Reduce vacuum cost delay to speed up cleanup

recommendations.command: kubectl exec -it postgres-primary-3a4b5-c6d7e -n database -- psql -c "DELETE FROM payments WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';"
recommendations.rationale: Archive old data to reduce storage footprint

remediation_validation: Confirm PostgreSQL can perform write operations
Validate replication lag reduced to < 1 minute
